tasks.title: Attach source_meta to regex-fallback hunt candidates so source-driving PoCs fire (source_meta leaf)
acceptance_criteria: `_candidate_from_hit` in `ngv2/hunt_lead_client.py` attaches `cand['source_meta']` (the verbatim `localize_source(abs_path, line)` dict) for fallback candidates whose source resolves to an HTTP route (`kind == 'http'`), via a fail-soft block placed immediately before the final `return cand`.

The `localize_source` import is FUNCTION-LOCAL (lazy: `from ngv2.source_localize import localize_source as _localize_source`), mirroring the existing `_sink_localize` usage pattern; the absolute path is resolved with `os.path.join(repo, path)` when `path` is not already absolute.
Non-HTTP sources (`kind != 'http'`) get NO `source_meta`; such candidates are left byte-for-byte identical to prior behavior.

Fail-soft: when `repo` is None / not a str, or `path` is falsy, or `localize_source` raises, no `source_meta` is attached and the function still returns the `cand` dict; the existing sink-localization logic is unchanged.

The entire rest of the module (the `_FALLBACK_MAX_CANDIDATES`, `_FALLBACK_CWE_PRIORITY`, `_FALLBACK_DROP_NONFORWARDING`, `_CONFIDENCE_RANK` module-level constants interleaved between functions, and the trailing lazy `from ngv2 import sink_localize as _sink_localize` try/except) is reproduced byte-for-byte; the ONLY change is the added block; no other file or function is touched.

New GREEN `tests/test_hunt_source_meta.py` (>= 3 concrete test functions) pins: source_meta attachment for a flask HTTP route (kind=='http', framework=='flask', param_name=='cmd'), no populated source_meta for a non-http source, and fail-soft (no source_meta, still a dict) for repo=None.
Both files are delivered as a single `__JANUSMASK_MANIFEST__` containing the WHOLE content of both files; `__JANUSMASK_PATCHES__` is NOT used.

spec.objective: Make the regex/pattern-scanner fallback candidate path in `ngv2/hunt_lead_client.py::_candidate_from_hit` attach a taint-SOURCE `source_meta` dict (from `source_localize.localize_source`) to each candidate whose source is an HTTP route, mirroring what `codeql_lead_source.py` already does, so `poc_writer.is_source_driving()` returns True and a SOURCE-DRIVING PoC is rendered instead of the import-the-sink fallback skeleton.
functional_requirements: In `_candidate_from_hit(hit, target, repo=None)`, immediately before the final `return cand`, add a fail-soft source-localization block that, when `isinstance(repo, str)` and `path` is truthy, lazily imports `localize_source`, resolves `abs_src = os.path.join(repo, path) if not os.path.isabs(path) else path`, calls `_localize_source(abs_src, line or 0)`, and sets `cand['source_meta'] = _smeta` ONLY when the result is a dict with `_smeta.get('kind') == 'http'`.
Do NOT attach `source_meta` when the source is not an HTTP route (`kind != 'http'`); such candidates must be left exactly as before.

Fail-soft behavior: wrap the localization in `try/except Exception: pass`; when `repo` is None or not a str, or `path` is falsy, skip the block entirely; `_candidate_from_hit` must always return the `cand` dict and must not alter the existing sink-localization logic (`sink_symbol`/`entrypoint`/`_sink_confidence`).

Deliver BOTH files via a single `__JANUSMASK_MANIFEST__` reproducing `ngv2/hunt_lead_client.py` byte-for-byte aside from the one added block (including the interspersed module-level constants and trailing lazy `_sink_localize` import), plus the new GREEN `tests/test_hunt_source_meta.py`; touch no other file and no other function (do NOT use `__JANUSMASK_PATCHES__`).
spec.interfaces: ngv2/hunt_lead_client.py::_candidate_from_hit(hit, target, repo=None) -> dict. Reads path=hit.get('file'), line=hit.get('line'); already calls _sink_localize.localize_sink(abs_path, line, ...) for SINK localization. `os` is imported at module scope; the source import must be function-local: `from ngv2.source_localize import localize_source as _localize_source`. localize_source(file_path, line) -> dict returns {'kind','framework','route_path','http_method','param_name','app_object','app_factory','symbol','confidence'}; this dict is attached verbatim as cand['source_meta'], which is exactly what poc_writer._overlay_source_meta consumes and what is_source_driving (source_kind=='http' + framework in (flask,fastapi) + (app_object or app_factory)) requires.
edge_cases: repo=None (or non-str): block is skipped, no source_meta, cand still returned (fail-soft, unchanged behavior).
path is falsy (empty/None): block is skipped, no source_meta.
localize_source raises (unparseable file, missing file, AST error): exception swallowed, no source_meta, cand still returned.
Source is a plain module-level function with no HTTP route (kind != 'http'): no source_meta key populated; candidate identical to prior behavior.
path already absolute: abs_src must use path as-is (no double-join with repo).
flask need not be installed at test time -- localize_source is pure-AST, so the test must remain hermetic (write temp files, no network).
non_goals: INTEGRATION beyond these two files is out of scope -- the word integration is explicitly named here as a non-goal.
Do NOT edit `_normalize_candidate` (the agy LLM path, a separate follow-up that needs repo threading).
Do NOT edit `lead_client`, `poc_writer.py`, `codeql_lead_source.py`, `source_localize.py`, or any file other than the two listed.
Do NOT change the sink-localization logic.
Do NOT decompose into more than one task; do NOT emit `__JANUSMASK_PATCHES__`; do NOT include a mutation_target.
spec.implementation_notes:
DELIVERY: emit a single `__JANUSMASK_MANIFEST__` (NOT `__JANUSMASK_PATCHES__`) containing the WHOLE content of BOTH files. The implementer MUST first READ the real `ngv2/hunt_lead_client.py` from the working repo (working_dir /home/xnihil0zer0/NobleGreedv2) and reproduce it verbatim, changing ONLY the single added block. Keep all `"""` docstrings as triple-double-quotes; do NOT emit `'''` or backslash-escaped quotes inside file bodies; preserve the module-level constants (`_FALLBACK_MAX_CANDIDATES`, `_FALLBACK_CWE_PRIORITY`, `_FALLBACK_DROP_NONFORWARDING`, `_CONFIDENCE_RANK`) and the trailing lazy `from ngv2 import sink_localize as _sink_localize` try/except exactly where they are.

EXACT BLOCK to insert in `_candidate_from_hit` immediately before the final `return cand` (mirrors the existing sink-localization pattern):

    if isinstance(repo, str) and path:
        try:
            from ngv2.source_localize import localize_source as _localize_source
            abs_src = os.path.join(repo, path) if not os.path.isabs(path) else path
            _smeta = _localize_source(abs_src, line or 0)
            if isinstance(_smeta, dict) and _smeta.get('kind') == 'http':
                cand['source_meta'] = _smeta
        except Exception:
            pass
    return cand

TEST (`tests/test_hunt_source_meta.py`, author GREEN in this same task, hermetic, >= 3 concrete test functions, no `assert True`):
- `from ngv2.hunt_lead_client import _candidate_from_hit`.
- HTTP case: write a temp dir with `vuln.py` containing `app = Flask(__name__)` at module level, an `@app.route("/run")` handler that reads `request.args.get("cmd")` and passes it to `subprocess.Popen(cmd, shell=True)`. Build hit `{'file': 'vuln.py', 'line': <the request.args line number>, 'code': '<that line text>', 'cwe': 'CWE-78', 'severity': 'high'}`. Assert `_candidate_from_hit(hit, target='t', repo=<tmpdir>)` returns a cand with `cand['source_meta']['kind'] == 'http'`, `['framework'] == 'flask'`, `['param_name'] == 'cmd'`.
- NON-http case: temp file with a plain module-level function (no route); assert the cand has NO populated source_meta (key absent or its `kind` != 'http').
- repo=None case: assert no source_meta and the function still returns a dict (fail-soft, unchanged).

# CREDENTIAL-NAMING CONSTRAINT (the AST security gate FAILS the build if a variable whose name contains (case-insensitive) "password", "secret", or "key" is assigned a string literal -- it reads as a hardcoded credential even though this is an external clean-room target with no real secret). NEVER bind a string literal to such a variable. Use a neutral name instead (field_name, check_id, label, name, ident, column) or iterate a collection literal / build the mapping from a list of tuples. This applies to dict keys held in a temp var, field labels, and constant identifiers.

# STDLIB-ONLY CONSTRAINT (the verification environment installs NO third-party packages, so importing one fails collection -> the whole build is rolled back and the leaf is parked). Import ONLY the Python standard library. Import NO third-party package: NO pydantic, NO pydantic_settings, NO attrs, NO pyyaml, NO numpy, NO requests, etc. For data models / config use stdlib dataclasses (dataclasses.dataclass), enum.Enum, typing, and plain dict / json instead of pydantic BaseModel / BaseSettings. If the spec mentions pydantic-style validation, re-express it with stdlib dataclasses + manual checks.

# DETERMINISM CONSTRAINT (the AST nondeterminism gate FAILS the build if it sees a wall-clock or nondeterministic source). Do NOT call datetime.now / datetime.utcnow, time.time / time.monotonic, unseeded random, uuid, os.urandom, or secrets to obtain a timestamp / id / randomness. Instead accept any timestamp, seed, or clock as an EXPLICIT parameter with a deterministic default (the oracle injects it, e.g. via now_fn / make_scripted_clock), so the same inputs always produce the same output.

test_spec.test_data_requirements: Hermetic temp directories created via tempfile; a flask `vuln.py` source (Flask app object + @app.route("/run") reading request.args.get("cmd") into subprocess.Popen(cmd, shell=True)) and a plain non-route module. NO network. flask need NOT be installed (localize_source is pure-AST). hit dicts shaped {'file','line','code','cwe','severity'}.

token_budget_ratio.note: Implementation is a one-block edit reproduced inside a whole-file manifest plus a small hermetic test; test budget kept >= 1.5x impl to honor the test-first emphasis (3+ concrete behaviors pinning attach/non-attach/fail-soft).
